methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was confirmed from each vendor's official pricing page fetched on 2026-06-14. Vendors that publish self-serve prices were captured with exact month-to-month rates as monthlyUsd and annual-billing rates noted where available. annualDiscountPct is calculated from published month-to-month vs annual rates. Vendors whose pricing pages show only 'Request Pricing' / 'Contact Sales' (ServiceTitan, Workiz, FieldEdge, FieldPulse) are recorded with monthlyUsd: null for all plans. Workiz pricing page (workiz.com/pricing-plans/) listed plan names but no dollar figures; FieldEdge and FieldPulse similarly gate all pricing behind demo requests. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on every plan as this is non-telephony software. Capterra (capterra.com) used as corroboration source for starting prices where direct-page corroboration was available. integrations lists are drawn from official integrations/features pages fetched on the same date.

vendors.name: Jobber
vendors.provenance: https://getjobber.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14; month-to-month rates used as monthlyUsd; annual prepaid rates and 1-year commitment rates noted)

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: 1 user included; additional users $29/mo each. Month-to-month $49/mo; 1-year commitment $39/mo; annual prepaid $29/mo (41% off vs month-to-month). Core scheduling, quoting, invoicing, client hub, mobile app.

plans.name: Connect
plans.notes: 5 users included; additional users $29/mo each. Month-to-month $139/mo; 1-year commitment $119/mo; annual prepaid $99/mo (29% off vs month-to-month). Adds job forms, routing, GPS tracking, automated emails/SMS, QuickBooks sync, custom fields, time tracking.

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: 10 users included; additional users $29/mo each. Month-to-month $199/mo; 1-year commitment $169/mo; annual prepaid $149/mo (25% off vs month-to-month). Adds automatic time tracking, job costing, two-way messaging, markups, automated quote follow-ups. Free 14-day trial uses this plan's features.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: 15 users included; additional users $29/mo each (contact sales for 16+ users). Month-to-month $699/mo; 1-year commitment $599/mo; annual prepaid $529/mo (24% off vs month-to-month). Adds marketing suite, AI receptionist, premium support, white-glove onboarding.

vendors.name: Housecall Pro
vendors.provenance: https://www.housecallpro.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14; month-to-month rates used as monthlyUsd; annual billing rates noted)

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: 1 user. Month-to-month $79/mo; annual billing $59/mo (25% off). Online booking, invoices and payments, scheduling and dispatching, quotes, review management, job cost tracking, price book, customer communication.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Up to 5 users. Month-to-month $189/mo; annual billing $149/mo (~21% off). All Basic features plus QuickBooks integration, marketing tools, equipment tracking, advanced review management, visual price book, GPS tracking, checklists.

plans.name: MAX
plans.notes: Up to 8 users; additional users $35/mo each. Month-to-month $329/mo; annual billing $299/mo (~9% off). All Essentials features plus advanced reporting, dedicated onboarding, escalated support, sales proposal tool, recurring service plans.

vendors.name: ServiceTitan
vendors.provenance: https://www.servicetitan.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14; all tiers show 'Request Pricing' — no dollar amounts published; per-technician billing model stated on page)

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Quote-only. Per-technician pricing. Includes dispatching, scheduling, call booking, invoicing, pricebook.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Quote-only. Per-technician pricing. Starter features plus mobile estimates and payroll management.

plans.name: The Works
plans.notes: Quote-only. Per-technician pricing. All Essentials features plus advanced reporting, commission tracking, customizable memberships.

vendors.name: Workiz
vendors.provenance: https://www.workiz.com/pricing-plans/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14; plan names listed but no dollar amounts published — all tiers require demo/quote request)

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Quote-only. Includes first 5 users. Essential tools for growing teams. Annual plan saves $400+ vs monthly. Additional users $55/mo (annual) per seat.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Quote-only. 'Most popular.' Includes first 5 users. AI tools and enhanced automations. Additional users $65/mo (annual) per seat.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: Quote-only. Built for mid-size and large companies, multi-location and franchises.

vendors.name: Service Fusion
vendors.provenance: https://www.servicefusion.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14; month-to-month rates used as monthlyUsd; annual rates (15% discount) noted; unlimited users on all plans)

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Unlimited users. Month-to-month $245/mo; annual billing $208/mo ($2,496/yr, 15% off). Customer management, estimates, scheduling, integrated payments, QuickBooks integration, invoicing, project management, reporting. No contract required.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Unlimited users. Month-to-month $382/mo; annual billing $325/mo ($3,900/yr, 15% off). All Starter features plus job photo uploads, inventory management, job costing, integrated voice and text communication.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Unlimited users. Month-to-month $627/mo; annual billing $533/mo ($6,396/yr, 15% off). All Plus features plus open API integration, custom documents, eSign documents, customer web portal, progressive billing.

vendors.name: Kickserv
vendors.provenance: https://www.kickserv.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14; month-to-month rates used as monthlyUsd; annual rates noted at 20% discount)

plans.name: Start
plans.notes: 5 users included. Month-to-month $60/mo; annual billing $48/mo (20% off). Embeddable contact form, automated email and text reminders, 20+ business reports, time tracking, expense tracking, QuickBooks Online integration.

plans.name: Run
plans.notes: 10 users included. Month-to-month $119/mo; annual billing $95.20/mo (20% off). All Start features plus dispatch mapping, GPS check-ins, custom data fields, custom reports, QuickBooks Desktop option ($50/mo add-on).

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: 20 users included. Month-to-month $199/mo; annual billing $159.20/mo (20% off). All Run features plus custom templates and reviews capability.
